items.title: Lionel Ferbos Interview, 1964-08-03
items.q: He taught René Hall and all them for that. ... What was his name? Willie what? Willie O'Connor.

ctx.x: Because Kuyper was there for a while. When I was at the tenors? No, no, no. You came after the kind of thing.

When I was in there it was a guitar player, a band-a-gill player's job. For that one? For that one. He taught René Hall and all them for that. He was a very good band-a-gill player and guitar player. What was his name? Willie what? Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Yeah. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor. Willie O'Connor.
